sections.title: How *consigning works*
sections.intro: Bring up to 15 items on a Monday between 10:30 am and 4:30 pm. For 15 to 30 items, book a Tuesday-to-Friday appointment so you don’t wait. The yearly consignment fee is $15.

columns.title: When we take what
items: July, August, December and January: high-end items by appointment

columns.title: We take
items: Formal wear, accessories, jewelry and designer perfume

columns.title: We don’t take
items: Anything with an odor or in poor condition
Fast-fashion labels such as Old Navy or Target’s brands

items.title: Clean & pressed
items.text: Freshly laundered, stain-free and wrinkle-free pieces sell faster, and for more.

items.title: On hangers
items.text: Bring everything on hangers, with dry-cleaning tags left on. Hangers come back on request.

items.title: We price it
items.text: We price each item ourselves, and welcome your input on couture, furs and one-of-a-kind pieces.

items.a: Yes, by appointment, for large consignments, estates and elderly consignors. There’s a $35 fee.
We take great care to check. If we know an item isn’t authentic, its tag says “faux”, and we ask you to point out anything you’re unsure of before you buy.

items.q: Can I check my consignor account online?
items.a: Yes. Consignors can see their account online at any time.

items.q: Is there a waiting list for handbags?
items.a: Yes, there’s a waiting list for high-end purses, so they tend to sell quickly. Consign yours now.

sections.title: Clean out your closet
sections.text: Consignments on Mondays, 10:30 to 4:30. Call ahead for 15 items or more.
